risk_note: 'tracked_in_git' does NOT by itself mean an asset survives the G: mount dying, because .git also lives on G:. An asset is safe when off_device_copy is true: either a copy exists on local disk (on_local_backup) or its blob is reachable from a remote ref (on_remote_ref), i.e. actually pushed to GitHub.
